title: Extension of scalars commutes with intrinsic realization and pullback
statement: Let φ:A→B be a map of finite commutative rings, p:Z→Y any scheme morphism and C an arbitrary object of D(Y_et,A). Let F and a be the intrinsic realization and its inverse-mate pullback comparison [def-fix-etale-origin-scalar-pullback-data]. Let σ_T:F_T^A S_T≅S_et F_T^B be siteScalarIso [def-finite-compact-scalar-transport-data] and c_i:L_B S_Y→S_Z L_A the specified intrinsic scalar pullback. Then L_B(σ_Y.inv_C);c_i(F_Y^A C);S_Z(a_A(C)) = a_B(S_et C);F_Z^B(c_et(C));σ_Z.inv_(L_et,A C), where c_et is Etale.scalarPullbackIso.hom. This tensor-free cube concerns extension alone and includes no restriction functor or projection formula.

source.place: lemma-derived-pullback-composition (Tag 0D6D), derived tensor construction Tag 06YY, geometric adjunction Tag 07A6, and remark-compatible-with-diagram (Tag 0E48): extension-of-scalars face of the normalized coefficient comparison

proof.text: Identify the scalar-adjunction mate of realizationScalarIso.hom with the inverse derived realization/restriction square. The existing proved realization_scalar_unit lemma supplies precisely the unit equation, so mateEquiv_eq_of_unit gives the identification.

Paste that identity with the defining inverse-mate equation for pbcComparisonReduction and whisker by intrinsicSiteFunctorIso at both ends. Compatibility of mates with horizontal composition and top/bottom whiskering gives the mate of siteScalarIso.hom as properOriginRestrictionIso.inv.

The inverse intrinsic scalar/pullback comparison is the inverse scalar mate of originRestrictionPullback by its FourCorners construction. The proved representative normalization identifies the inverse etale scalar/pullback comparison with the scalar mate of scalarRestrictionPullbackIso.hom.

Apply injectivity of the scalar mates equivalence to the two pastings. After the identifications above, their mates are exactly the existing etaleOriginRestrictionPullbackCube. Evaluate the resulting reverse extension cube at C, and cancel the scalar/pullback and site/scalar isomorphisms to obtain the displayed forward cube. This is valid on all unbounded inputs and for zero rings and empty schemes, since it uses only adjunction identities and natural isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleOriginExtensionPullbackCube
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Z ⟶ Y)
    (C : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) Y) :
    (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback B p).map
        ((Scheme.FiniteCompactScalar.siteScalarIso φ Y).inv.app C) ≫
      (directImageScalarPullbackIso φ p).hom.app
        ((finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Y A).obj C) ≫
      (directImageScalarExtension φ Z).map ((originPullback A p).app C) =
    (originPullback B p).app
        ((Etale.scalarExtension (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) Y).obj C) ≫
      (finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Z B).map
        ((Etale.scalarPullbackIso (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) p).hom.app C) ≫
      (Scheme.FiniteCompactScalar.siteScalarIso φ Z).inv.app
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) p).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
          C)
